description:
Remove backend tests that re-prove what the shared conformance suite owns.

## Background

Both `IssueStore` backends run one shared conformance suite. Backend test modules in `crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs`, `storage/memory.rs` and `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs` predate it and test reader and writer behaviour per backend.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No test in `storage/json.rs`, `storage/memory.rs` or `repository_state_store_tests.rs` re-proves a property the conformance suite owns.
- [hard] REQ-02: Tests of backend-specific behaviour remain, such as atomic file publication, redo records, locking and the memory interruption view.
title: Backend tests keep only backend-specific behaviour
